LUXORA X1

Cinematic Experience

Engineering

Sound, perfected.

Every millimeter of the LUXORA X1 has been meticulously crafted to deliver an uncompromising auditory journey.

Neural Acoustics

Adaptive real-time tuning that perfectly maps to the unique geometry of your ear.

Powered by a dedicated bionic engine, the X1 analyzes ambient sound signatures 50,000 times per second, ensuring absolute fidelity and lossless playback in any environment.

Spatial 360° Sphere

Immersive, multidimensional sound that places you at the center of the recording.

Advanced dynamic head tracking algorithms create a breathtaking theater-grade soundstage. Every instrument, every breath, precisely positioned in the space around you.

Absolute Silence

Our most advanced Active Noise Cancellation architecture to date.

Six outward-facing acoustic sensors detect and completely neutralize external noise before it reaches your ear. A seamless Transparency Mode lets the world back in with a tap.

Endless Autonomy

40 hours of uninterrupted high-fidelity listening on a single charge.

Intelligent power management paired with a high-density battery cell. A mere 10-minute charge delivers 5 hours of playback. The included Smart Case preserves power automatically.

Intuitive Touch

Seamlessly orchestrate your audio with absolute precision.

Invisible capacitive sensors embedded within the aerospace-grade aluminum ear cups. Swipe to adjust volume, tap to skip, or hold to summon your voice assistant.

Crystal Clarity

Studio-grade vocal isolation for pristine communication.

Dual beamforming microphones actively filter out wind and background interference, isolating your voice so you are heard with perfect clarity, no matter where you are.

Crafted from

Acoustic Architecture

Every millimeter of the interior chamber has been precisely calculated to reduce resonance and eliminate distortion. The result is a soundstage so vast, you'll feel like you're in the room with the artist.
